summary.Summary:
Sacco System's speaker, joined mid-introduction by the recording, presented the company as a probiotic maker and CDMO that sells speed and flexibility. It is a family company founded in 1872, selling in more than 110 countries, with plants in Italy and the US and a pilot for next-generation strains in Australia.

He described its offer: probiotics, postbiotics and custom mixtures from strains screened to EFSA requirements, and a service that develops strains for third parties. Sacco has recently invested in clinical studies and patents in two areas, women's health and healthy ageing, and he gave one strain for each.

CA15, a patented strain isolated from healthy women, was tested in women with vaginal infections. He reported fewer symptoms and, one month after intake stopped, most women with a restored pH.

Symbio, a mix of two strains isolated from centenarians, was tested over six months in 97 elderly subjects. He reported more beneficial bacteria, a 43% reduction in a marker of inflammation, better IGF-1, which he linked to muscle mass, and a slower shortening of telomeres.

His close was an invitation: Sacco will take on unusual projects quickly and work closely with the customer.
summary.Key takeaways:
- Its pitch as a CDMO is speed and flexibility: a low time to market, working in synergy with the customer, and setting up a new kind of production if asked ("If you have got something crazy, we like to do that") [00:00].
- Offer: probiotics, postbiotics and customised mixtures; "culture science" strains with clinical studies and "culture select" strains screened to EFSA requirements, more than 30 species; strain development for third parties [00:00].
- CA15 (women's health): patented strain, 2022; six-woman exploratory study then 200 women; "10 mil per capsule" for 10 days, one-month washout; he reported reduced symptoms and, one month after intake stopped, 98% restored pH and 92% negative amine test [00:00].
- Symbio (healthy ageing): 1:1 paracasei and rhamnosus from Marche centenarians; a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled study in 97 subjects, "five mil" daily, six months [00:00].
- Symbio results as he gave them: more lactobacilli, bifidobacteria and butyrate, a 43% reduction in hs-CRP ("a marker of inflammaging"), reduced TNF, improved IGF-1 "correlated with the protein synthesis as well as the maintenance of the muscle mass", and "a decrease in the reduction in the length" of telomeres [00:00].
- Sacco has recently invested in clinical studies and patents in two areas, women's health and healthy ageing [00:00].
summary.For Vita Actives:
- Medium relevance. Sacco is a probiotic ingredient maker and CDMO, so it shows who makes the probiotic part of our customers' products, not a buyer for ours.
- The one direct touch-point is the healthy-ageing pitch: Symbio was presented with a muscle-mass argument through IGF-1 and sarcopenia, the territory where creatine and protein are pitched to active-ageing brands [00:00]. My reading: expect active-ageing launches that pair a probiotic with creatine or protein, and a CreaWin "muscle plus gut" story with a partner like Sacco is a possible co-formulation pitch.
- The claims are the speaker's, from one 97-subject study whose publication was not named. No protein, creatine or sports nutrition was mentioned.

items.title: SPI Pharma and Nordic Biotic: new dosage forms and clinically tested strains
ingredients: Composol Pro Tab (SPI Pharma, as heard; polyol-based chewable platform)

summary.Summary:
Two suppliers shared this slot. Miguel of SPI Pharma, joined mid-talk by the recording, argued that CDMOs can grow by moving probiotics and other actives into new dosage forms, and showed three concepts.

The first was a chewable probiotic tablet, made on a low-moisture platform and pressed gently so the bacteria survive. The second was effervescent hydration formats, kept stable with a modified sodium bicarbonate; a light fizz also helps mask bitterness. The third was fast-melt tablets for children, older people who struggle to swallow, and anyone who dislikes pills. His close, aimed at the capsule maker ACG: do not ask consumers to swallow another capsule.

Mihail Jakubowski of Nordic Biotic then presented a supplier of clinically tested probiotic strains, sold with exclusivity by territory. Its work runs from genomics and metabolomics to human studies. He showed a stress and sleep blend tested on 227 students at exam time, saying the results, received the week before, proved efficacy on sleep quality and stress. He also showed a blend aimed at microplastics, with its human study still in progress.

His close was an invitation to develop new products together.
summary.Key takeaways:
- Chewable probiotic tablets: a polyol-based platform with low water content and water activity, compressed at low force, sweet without sugar; probiotics survive the process; shown in a real Favea product [00:01].
- Effer Soda is SPI Pharma's stabilised sodium bicarbonate for effervescent tablets, stick packs and sachets; plain bicarbonate with an acid is hygroscopic and unstable over shelf life [00:01].
- Fast-melt tablets need no water and suit children, elderly people with dysphagia and people who dislike swallowing; SPI Pharma offers an ODT platform that can carry fizz [00:01].
- Nordic Biotic: full exclusivity by territory at strain level; genomics, then metabolomics (630 molecules, "the postbiotics actually"), then functional testing, then human studies [09:25].
- Mental Balance: eight-week study, 227 students started, 219 completed, "one of the largest study in stress in probiotics in the last decade"; results received last week; he said statistical efficacy was proved in sleep quality and stress [09:25].
- Nordic Biotic has a GLP-1 companion product with its Swiss sister company Azento [09:25].
summary.For Vita Actives:
- Medium relevance, the highest of the four: formats, not ingredients. Hydration sticks, effervescent tablets, chewables and fast melts are the formats our sports and active nutrition customers sell, and SPI Pharma's platforms are what a CDMO uses to make them.
- My reading: a CreaWin chewable or fast-melt tablet, and creatine or electrolytes in a stable effervescent stick, are format questions to raise with the CDMOs who work with SPI Pharma and Favea; Favea (shown making a live product) is a CDMO to know.
- My reading: Nordic Biotic's GLP-1 companion product is the adjacent opportunity for IsoClr: Pea, since protein for muscle preservation on GLP-1 drugs is a brief our customers already have; its stress and sleep blend sits next to recovery positioning in active nutrition.
- Nordic Biotic's exclusivity-by-territory model is a pattern a branded ingredient supplier can study (my reading).
- All efficacy claims are the speakers' and the Mental Balance study is unpublished as of the talk.

detail.text: The chewable platform was heard as "composol pro tab"; the live product was shown under Favea's branding [00:01].
Hydration is a trend in supplements and beverages. Effer Soda is a sodium bicarbonate partly transformed to carbonate to form a protective layer [00:01].
A "delicate fizz" in chewables or fast melts is also a way to distract the tongue from bitterness [00:01].
SPI Pharma's role, as he put it, is creating product concepts so a CDMO can expand into new dosage forms; "we do not limit there" [00:01].
Nordic Biotic, a silver sponsor, supplies clinically tested probiotics to brand owners, CDMOs and distributors; CFU is measured to milligrams [09:25].

Mental Balance (Northbiotic Mental Balance): strains chosen for what they produce, Lactobacillus plantarum 140 (GABA) and Bifidobacterium breve 010 (a B vitamin); tested in students at exam time [09:25].

Microplastic blend: Lactobacillus acidophilus 120 aggregates (binds) microplastic, Lactobacillus fermentum 160 pushes it away; offered as a standalone or an add-on to a gut, detox or clean-label formula; human study in progress, with an invitation to a "plastic gut-free initiative" [09:25].
Gut-skin, gut-bone and gut-brain technologies were named [09:25].
WIPO innovation index as he cited it: of 12 countries, seven are European; in the region Latvia, Czechia, Hungary and Poland lead [09:25].
His closing line: "We will not proudly invent the the next wheel in the next week, but I'm pretty sure we can create something new together." [09:25]
The chair's aside: Coca-Cola was first sold as a medicinal tonic for brain and nerves [08:30].
